required_closures: S1: Production API has no reviewed-SHA override. None blocks. Use one canonical packet schema and verify detached exact packet bytes/hash plus plans, preregs, registry, source/footer/manifest/clock, tool/test and path identities. Implement one-shot preflight, exclusive marker fsync+directory fsync+readback, in-process custody/narrow/build/validate, sanitized terminal evidence and guaranteed finally self-disarm. A complete canonical synthetic packet must demonstrably PASS; missing/extra/mutated fields fail before marker/raw.

S2: Remove the permissive production read path. NarrowDesignCapability itself consumes before reader and never resets after reader/hash/schema failure. Raw and every selected date each have an attempted-open counter and exact one-call maximum.

S3: Construct authority only from the verified full packet and exact frozen constants. Marker binds every S3 field from base task packet. Decode one monolith buffer and enforce exact 71,785 rows, one row group, exact ordered Arrow schema/types, all-field null rules, finite positive OHLC/envelope, nonnegative integer volume/spread/real-volume, bound FivePercent clock function and exact-once four-way split reconciliation.

Reject duplicate/noncanonical dates, wrong date-set SHA, missing/duplicate mapping, extras-count mismatch and recursive feature/economic/path/capability leakage before the first selected read. Builder receives only exact approved keys/values.

S5: Production contract hard-binds canonical roots, exactly 1297 dates and 9079 rows. Stage/output/evidence must be absent, not merely empty. Walk all components no-follow and reject symlink/junction/reparse/mount/ADS/hardlink; capture and recheck identities around every read and atomic publication with durable readback.

S6: Validator independently enumerates exact directories and regular files no-follow, rejecting empty extra directories, links/reparse/ADS/hardlinks and every extra file. Enforce exact JSON keys/types recursively, recompute all date/request/trace/tree/source chains including input_day_sha256 against custody mapping, and check every shard one-row-group/schema/row/null/value/clock/7-times-per-date invariant. Nested economic_leak, three row groups, auxiliary nulls and hardlinked expected shard must fail.
